title: Touring Barcelona!
text: We were delighted to have Montse as our personal tour guide.  She was mindful of our age while walking and took extra steps to keep us safe on the metro.  Montse is very knowledgeable about the city and was able to answer all of our questions. I would highly recommend her for your tour.
author: gloriasY5640VA

title: Best Views
text: What a great way to experience a guided tour through the hustle and bustle of Barcelona. Part of the way, we actually hopped on the Metro, so great to be amongst the locals (rather than just fellow tourists). The cable car ride to Montjuic Castle gave great views of Barcelona. There is a lot of history to learn about Montjuic Castle and Miguel. our tour guide explained and gave details wonderfully. The views from Montjuic Castle are unmatched. title: Thoroughly enjoyable and interesting tour. Being an architect my self I found it a great tour.
text:
The tour was very good. The tour guide Stephanie was excellent and her passion for historical architecture made the tour even more enjoyable. 
When my wife's knees started to hurt she was very concerned and kept enquiring if my wife was OK. 
Our only issue we had with the tour which does in no way reflect on Stephanie, was that although the tour was advertised as a walking tour, we think it would be useful to advertise going forward the length and topography of the walking element of the tour.
author: 178grahamg

title: Very good
text: I arrived at the meeting point in the morning and met the friendly guide Montse. When she learned that I was from China and my English was not fluent, she kindly helped me, starting our journey. Throughout the trip, she took great care of my feelings and provided detailed explanations of the streets and castles of Barcelona, as well as the city's development history, humanistic history, and culture.
